'''FC Skuri''', occasionally also spelled as '''Squri''', is a [[Georgia (country)|Georgian]] [[football (soccer)|football]] club,<ref name="soccerway">{{cite web|url=https://int.soccerway.com/teams/georgia/skuri-chalendjikha/10046/|title=Georgia – FC Skuri Tsalenjikha – Results, fixtures, squad, statistics, photos, videos and news – Soccerway|publisher=uk.soccerway.com|accessdate=2015-02-18}}</ref> based in the town of [[Tsalenjikha]]. Currently they compete in [[Liga 4 (Georgia)|Liga 4]], the fourth tier of [[Football in Georgia (country)|Georgian football]]."}}
